definitions.supplemental: fangen; pp. of fón to take, q. v.

source_text: fang, es; m. [fangen; pp. of fón to take, q. v.] what is taken, A booty; capt&u-long;ra, præda :-- Hí fang woldon fón they would take booty, Chr. 1016; Th. 281, 30. [Laym. feng, ueng booty: Scot. fang a capture: O. Frs. fang, feng, m: Dut. vang, m: Ger. fang, m: M. H. Ger. vanc, m: O. H. Ger. fang, m. capt&u-long;ra: Dan. fang, n: Swed. fång, n: Icel. fang, n. a catching.] DER. feax-fang, feoh-, fore-, for-, under-.
